tasks.short: She maintains student attendance, grades, and other required records.

steps.what: Maintain student attendance records for each studio session.
Maintain grades and other required records in the learning system.
Retype each entered grade into the student information system.

tasks.design: She keeps attendance, grades, and other required records in the {LMS}, and today she retypes each grade into the {OTHER} student information system. A pass-back writes the grade she already entered, and she still chooses every grade. Only that second typing stops.
tasks.previous_blocker: The learning system and the student information system do not share the grade, so she types it a second time.
tasks.enabler_now: The grade she entered is already structured in the {LMS}, and a pass-back can write it into the student information system. No model is used. Closed-question marking and rubric comments are other tasks.
tasks.still_hard: She still decides the grade and still enters it the first time. If the pass-back is down, she retypes it herself.
tasks.human_edge: The result is hers. A pass-back cannot decide what the studio work earned.
tasks.altitude: Attendance and the first grade entry stay in her week. She no longer retypes a grade she has already entered. She gains no right to let a model set the result.

reach.task: Publish a learning-system grade into the student information system.
reach.learn: Only a grade the architecture teacher has already entered is written across, and the coordinator does not set the result.

evidence.claim: A grade held in the learning system must also be published in the student information system.
Examiners appointed by the examination board set the result.

assumptions: Today she retypes each grade into the student information system after she has entered it in the learning system. That second typing is the work removed.
Student identifier and course code already exist in both systems. The fields written across are the student, the course, and the grade she entered.
Attendance and the other required records stay in the learning system. They are not typed a second time.
If a registrar already publishes the grade, or this course has no second system, her saving on this task is zero.
If the pass-back is missing, she retypes the grades herself.
Incremental upkeep is zero. No template, mapping, or list is added.
unknowns: Whether she, a registrar, or both publish the grade into the student information system today.
Whether this learning system already offers a grade pass-back to the student information system.
research_questions: For one course, how many minutes does she spend retyping the grade set into the student information system?
Who publishes the official grade when the two systems disagree?

already_counted.description: She still enters the grade in the learning system, and that entry is the version the second publication uses.

incremental.description: No template, mapping, or list is kept. Upkeep hours are zero.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: The high is only the second typing of a grade she has already entered in the learning system. The low is zero when a registrar already publishes that grade, or when the course has no second system. Attendance and the first entry stay.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: She initiates, facilitates, and moderates classroom discussions.

steps.what: Initiate, facilitate, and moderate classroom discussions.

tasks.design: The classroom discussion stays with her in the studio. No note is added before or after it. Item banks, rubric comments, and the grade pass-back are other tasks.
tasks.previous_blocker: The discussion is live talk with the students about the work in front of them.
tasks.enabler_now: The digest keeps lecturing with the teacher, and this task is that room. Item banks and the grade pass-back belong to other tasks, so nothing here changes.
tasks.still_hard: She has to read the room, choose who speaks, and answer the design question in the moment.
tasks.human_edge: Students take the critique from her, in the studio, while the work is there.
tasks.altitude: Her week of classroom discussion is unchanged. She gains no right to skip the discussion.

reach.learn: The discussion stays a live conversation with the students, and a written prompt does not replace it.

evidence.claim: Leading a classroom discussion is live teaching, and the digest keeps lecturing with the teacher.

assumptions: This task is the live discussion. A prep note or a discussion log is not part of it.
Incremental upkeep is zero. No template, mapping, or list is added.
unknowns: Whether this school requires a written record of the discussion.
research_questions: Does this studio require a written record of the discussion, or only the conversation?

already_counted.description: The whole discussion remains her live work.

incremental.description: No template, mapping, or list is kept. Upkeep hours are zero.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: The discussion stays in the room. The low and the high are zero because no second entry or transport is removed.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: She reads, talks with colleagues, and attends conferences to keep abreast.

steps.what: Stay abreast of architectural field developments by reading current literature.
She stays abreast by talking with colleagues on architectural field developments.
She stays abreast by participating in professional architectural conferences.

tasks.design: She still reads the current literature, still talks with colleagues, and still goes to the conferences. No literature feed is added. Bibliography tools serve a different task.
tasks.previous_blocker: The developments sit in papers, in colleague talk, and in the conference room.
tasks.enabler_now: Bibliography tools in the digest serve compiling bibliographies, which is a different task. This task is her reading, her colleague talk, and her conferences, and the digest does not document a change for that participation.
tasks.still_hard: She has to judge which development matters for the studio she teaches.
tasks.human_edge: She chooses what enters the course. A list of titles would not make that choice.
tasks.altitude: Her reading, her colleague talk, and her conferences stay in the week. She gains no right to skip them.

reach.task: Point a teacher to current architectural literature.
reach.learn: Reading the field stays the teacher's time, and a bibliography aid is a different task.

evidence.claim: Keeping abreast here is reading, colleague talk, and conferences. A bibliography aid belongs to a different task and is not applied to this time.

assumptions: She issues no written finding from the reading. The colleague talk is not a versioned send.
Conference attendance is her participation. No feed replaces the trip.
Incremental upkeep is zero. No template, mapping, or list is added.
unknowns: How this school splits her year between reading, colleague talk, and conferences.
research_questions: Which developments from the last conference actually changed a studio brief she teaches?

already_counted.description: Reading, colleague talk, and the conferences all remain her work.

incremental.description: No template, mapping, or list is kept. Upkeep hours are zero.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Reading, colleague talk, and conferences stay as they are. The low and the high are zero because no second entry or transport is removed.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: She compiles, administers, and grades examinations, or assigns them.

steps.what: Compile examinations as architectural design briefs.
She will assign examinations to others when she will not mark them.
She will administer examinations in the studio or the exam room.
She will grade examinations from the drawings and models she saw.

tasks.design: She still compiles the examination as a design brief, still assigns marking when someone else will do it, still administers the sitting, and still sets the grade from the drawings and models. Closed-question banks are for papers with many alike responses, and this examination is a studio brief. Publishing the grade into a second system sits on the records task.
tasks.previous_blocker: The examination is a brief and a set of drawings, not a bank of closed items.
tasks.enabler_now: Closed-question marking and grouping of similar short answers apply where many answers look alike. An architecture examination is a design brief and a jury of drawings, so compiling, administering, grading, and assigning that work stay with her. The digest keeps the grade decision with the examiner.
tasks.still_hard: She has to judge the drawing against the brief. A model must not set that result.
tasks.human_edge: The grade is her judgement of work she saw. The appointed examiner sets the result.
tasks.altitude: Compiling, administering, grading, and assigning the examination stay in her week. She gains no right to let a model set the result.

reach.task: Mark an examination the teacher assigned.
reach.learn: The assistant marks only work she assigned, and the result stays with the appointed examiner.

evidence.claim: An architecture examination is typically a design brief judged from drawings and models, so closed-question marking is not this task's time.
Examiners appointed by the examination board set the result.

assumptions: When she assigns the marking, the assistant's marking time is not in this task. Her share is the assigning.
Publishing the grade into the student information system is the records task, not this one.
This examination is a design brief and a jury. It is not a closed-question paper.
Incremental upkeep is zero. No template, mapping, or list is added.
unknowns: How often she assigns the marking, and how often she grades the jury herself.
research_questions: In one term, what share of these examinations is a studio jury rather than a closed-question paper?

already_counted.description: Compiling, assigning, administering, and grading all remain her work.

incremental.description: No template, mapping, or list is kept. Upkeep hours are zero.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: The brief, the assignment, the sitting, and the grade decision stay with her. The low and the high are zero because no second entry is removed on this task.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

role.altitude: The discussion, the reading, the conferences, and the examination grade stay hers. The only change is that a grade she has already entered is written into the student information system without a second typing. She gains no right to let a model set a result.
skills_to_grow: Lead the studio discussion from the work in the room.
Judge which architectural development belongs in the course.
Set an examination brief a jury can mark from drawings and models.
Enter the grade herself before anything writes it into the student information system.
role.ambitious_version: She still leads every classroom discussion, still reads the field and sits the conferences, and still compiles, administers, and grades the examination or assigns that work. A grade she has entered can be published once. She does not gain a right to let a model set the result.
